entities.subtitle: Walmart shoplifting response, vehicle check, and K-9 discussion
entities.description: Car-to-car radio traffic from September 16, 2026. Officers coordinate a Walmart shoplifting response and positions near the store exits, locate a white Honda Odyssey registered to Tiffany Robertson, discuss two detained people, request a plain-view check, and discuss waiting for a K-9 and prior marijuana involvements. Later clips include possible officer-safety and citation follow-up; their connection to this incident is uncertain. The recordings do not establish whether a vehicle search or K-9 sniff occurred or whether detention was prolonged. Clips 124–145 are marked verified; the added context contains unverified and uncertain transcript wording.
